moqueca_p1_strong: The Moqueca that attracts and enchants tourists in Espírito Santo.
moqueca_p1: The ingredients used in its preparation do not attack the delicate flavor of fish, shrimp, crabs, lobsters and, finally, all seafood we use on our menu and, even coriander, with a strong taste, in the way it is administered only gives an extra touch to the aroma and enriches the palate. The clay pot is also very important and each moqueca is prepared individually, obeying a tradition where each product is added step by step.
moqueca_p2: The pirão is made with fine manioc flour, shredded fish and the same ingredients as the moqueca. White rice and farofinha with plantain complete our Capixaba moqueca.
desc_camarao_coco: Fresh shrimp prepared in a smooth and delicious white cream, accompanied by rice, crispy french fries and a homemade pepper sauce.
desc_casquinha_siri: Shredded crab seasoned with spices, bringing an irresistible flavor. A perfect starter for any meal, accompanied by butter farofa and homemade pepper sauce.
desc_moqueca_mista: A delicious combination of fish, pink shrimp, small shrimp, squid, mussels and lobster, served with traditional sides: white rice, banana farofa, pirão and homemade pepper sauce.
